payload.text: Standing safety on rhadamanth (hv via vc, 2026-11-03): Keychain inspection is metadata only, and no real login-keychain item is decrypted outside the code under test; no claude auth login or logout, and no ccusage login, logout or use, against real profiles; no profile points at ~/.config/claude (vc watch-out 1); no local build runs against the real XDG config until hv OKs the live check, because a renewal spends real tokens; a write to a disposable keychain names a file that exists and keeps its security -i line to 4097 bytes, newline included, because security adds to the default keychain when the named one is missing or when a split line loses its keychain argument; no push and no PR edit without hv's OK.
